data.description: Completes EMB-04 (w3) + EMB-12 (w2). Headshots are blocked THREE ways: no render, no field on PublicSpeakerSummary, and ZERO headshots in the seed (deliberate: no real people's images — pool.ts:5). Build: (1) seed deliberately-synthetic avatars (deterministic monogram/geometric SVG committed as static assets — NOT stock photos, NOT AI faces; attendees recognize speakers by face and a fake face is a lie) for the ~30 published speakers, leaving 2-3 photo-less on purpose (EMB-12 explicitly rewards the graceful fallback); (2) headshotUrl on PublicSpeakerSummary + parseSpeakers; (3) img with initials fallback on directory cards (coordinate with the directory ticket — read its board plan; it ships the slot), embed speaker kinds (EmbedPage.tsx:157,165), and /p/:slug. Do NOT wire the R2 media origin for this (production blast radius, zero rubric gain). Full spec: section T-I3. Register row 35.
